# War Scroll Column 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 8 | **Condition:** fragmentary (damage at bottom)

---

**8:1** And the horsemen-of the-cavalry shall-be-deployed in-two-wings, flanking the body-of the-formation, to-the-right and-to-the-left.

**8:2** And they-shall-set-out the-one-wing to-press against the-flank-of the-enemy, and the-other-wing to-press against their-rear, so-as-to-surround them.

**8:3** And the two-wings-of the-cavalry shall-go-forth together to-crush the-spirit-of the-enemy and to-scatter-them from-before the Sons-of-Light.

**8:4** And the horses-of the-battle shall-be stallions, trained-for-war, accustomed to-hearing the-sound-of-tumult and to-seeing sights-of-slaughter.

**8:5** And they-shall-not shy-away from any-sound nor be-terrified by-any-sight, but-rather they-shall-be strong-of-heart and swift-of-foot.

**8:6** And their-age shall-be from four years to eight years, and they-shall-be chosen from-the-lands-of the-wide-open-spaces where-the-pasture is-good.

**8:7** And they-shall-not be-driven to-exhaustion before battle, for they-must-be fresh and ready in-the-day-of-engagement.

**8:8** And those-who-ride-upon-them — the riders-of-the-cavalry — shall-be men from thirty years to forty-five years, mighty-men-of-war.

**8:9** And their-armor: a breastplate-of bronze upon-their-chests, and greaves-of bronze upon-their-legs, and a helmet-of bronze upon-their-heads.

**8:10** And a shield in-their-left-hand, and in-their-right-hand a lance-of battle, six cubits in-its-length, and a sword girded upon-their-thigh.

**8:11** And they-shall-ride into-the-spaces between the-battle-lines, and they-shall-not enter into-the-ranks-of the-infantry lest-they-trample-them.

**8:12** And when-the-cavalry charge, they-shall-ride between the-formations to-strike-down the-enemy, and the trumpeters shall-blow a signal for-their-advance.

**8:13** And the horsemen shall-pursue those-who-flee, and they-shall-cut-them-down until-they-are-consumed, and none shall-escape.

**8:14** And in-the-engagement-of the-battle, the cavalry shall-wheel to-the-right and-to-the-left [...] the flanks-of the-enemy.

**8:15** [...] and they-shall-press upon-them [...] and the slain shall-fall [...] before the Sons-of-Light.

**8:16** [...] the horsemen [...] the battle [...] the formation [...]

**8:17** [...] in-the-day-of [...] God [...] victory [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 8 is well preserved through line 13 but becomes increasingly fragmentary toward the bottom. Lines 14-17 show progressive manuscript damage. Horse specifications (age 4-8 years, lines 4-7) reflect practical military knowledge. Cavalry armor list (lines 9-10) parallels ancient Near Eastern military equipment catalogues.*
